subject: general
question: In March 2025, the Lok Sabha passed the Bills of Lading Bill, modernising how many years of old colonial shipping law?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**169 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Lok Sabha passed the **Bills of Lading Bill** in March 2025 to modernize colonial-era shipping laws.
 
• This Bill updates laws that have been in existence for **169 years**, dating back to the mid-19th century.
 
• The **Bills of Lading** is a significant document in the shipping industry, acting as proof of shipment and ownership of goods.
 
• The modernization reflects India's effort to align its maritime laws with **international shipping standards**.
 
• The Bill aims to enhance the **efficiency, transparency, and legal clarity** in the shipping and maritime domain.
 
• This reform is expected to boost India's maritime sector and promote ease of doing business.

__
 
• **175 years**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the colonial shipping laws being modernized date back to **1856**, making the duration **169 years** as of 2025.
 
 
 
• **150 years**__
 __
 
• This option underestimates the actual age of the colonial shipping laws, which are older than **150 years**.
 
 
 
• **120 years**__
 
 
• This option is significantly incorrect, as the colonial shipping laws date back to the **mid-19th century**, not the early 20th century.
